responses: If the order hasn't shipped yet, I can update the delivery address for you. What's the order number and the new address?
Once packed, items can't be added or swapped — but you can place a new order or return this one after delivery. Has your order shipped yet?

patterns: How long does delivery take?
How many days for shipping?
When will I get my order?
Delivery time to Nairobi
How fast is shipping to Mombasa?
Estimated delivery date
responses: Delivery within Nairobi typically takes 1–2 business days. Other major towns take 2–4 days, and remote areas may take up to 6 days.
Standard delivery is 2–5 business days depending on your location. Express delivery (Nairobi only) arrives within 24 hours for an extra fee.
It depends on your delivery location — could you tell me your county so I can give you a more accurate estimate?

patterns: How much is delivery?
What's the shipping fee?
Is shipping free?
Delivery charges to Kisumu
Do you charge for shipping?
responses: Shipping is free on orders over KES 3,000. Below that, standard delivery costs KES 200 within Nairobi and KES 350–500 upcountry.
Delivery fees vary by location and order weight, calculated automatically at checkout. Want me to estimate it for a specific address?
Free shipping applies to orders above KES 3,000. Otherwise it's a flat KES 200–500 depending on your county.

patterns: Do you ship outside Kenya?
Can I order from Uganda?

Do you deliver to Tanzania?
responses: Currently NeuralMart ships within Kenya only. We're working on expanding to other East African countries soon.
We don't offer international shipping yet, but you can sign up for our newsletter to be notified when that changes.

patterns: What is your return policy?
Can I return an item?

Is this item returnable?
responses: You can return most items within 7 days of delivery, as long as they're unused and in original packaging. Some categories (underwear, perishables, custom items) are non-returnable.
Our return window is 7 days from delivery. Item must be in original condition with tags/packaging intact. Would you like to start a return?

patterns: How do I return an item?
I want to return my order

How do returns work?
I need to return this shirt
responses: To start a return: go to 'My Orders', select the item, click 'Return Item', choose a reason, and either drop it at a pickup point or schedule a courier pickup. Want me to start this for you now?
I can help you begin a return. What's the order number and reason for the return (wrong size, damaged, not as described, etc.)?

patterns: Where is my refund?

How long does a refund take?
Check refund status
responses: Refunds to M-Pesa are typically processed within 3–5 business days after we receive the returned item. Card refunds can take 5–10 business days.
Let me check that for you — what's the order number or return reference ID?
Once your return is received at our warehouse, the refund is triggered automatically. Do you have the return tracking number?

patterns: Can I exchange for a different size?

responses: Yes, exchanges are available for size/color within 7 days of delivery, subject to stock. I can start that for you — what's the order number and the size/color you'd like instead?
We can exchange it if the new variant is in stock. Let me check availability — which product and size do you need?

patterns: Does this product have a warranty?

How long is the warranty?
responses: Warranty coverage depends on the product and manufacturer — typically 12 months for electronics and appliances. Check the product page under 'Warranty' for specifics.
Most electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Would you like me to check the exact warranty terms for a specific product?

That shouldn't have happened. Let's get this fixed — what's the order number? We'll prioritize a replacement or full refund.

responses: We accept M-Pesa, Visa/Mastercard, and Cash on Delivery (available in select areas). M-Pesa is the fastest and most popular option.
You can pay via M-Pesa STK Push, debit/credit card, or Cash on Delivery where available. Which would you like to use?

patterns: How do I pay with M-Pesa?

responses: At checkout, select M-Pesa, enter your phone number, and you'll receive an STK push prompt — just enter your M-Pesa PIN to confirm.
If you didn't get the STK prompt, check that your phone has network signal and try again, or dial *334# manually and use Paybill 400200 with your order number as the account reference.
Sorry about that. If the payment was deducted but the order isn't confirmed, it usually resolves within 10 minutes. If not, share your M-Pesa transaction code and I'll investigate.

patterns: My payment didn't go through

responses: Sorry for the trouble. Could you tell me which payment method you used and share the transaction reference? I'll check what happened.

If money was deducted but your order isn't confirmed, it's usually a delayed confirmation — it typically resolves within 10–15 minutes. If it doesn't, we'll refund you automatically within 3 business days.

patterns: Is it safe to pay on this site?

responses: Yes — all payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant, encrypted gateways. We never store your full card number or M-Pesa PIN on our servers.
Your payment details are fully encrypted and processed via secure, licensed payment providers. NeuralMart never has access to your M-Pesa PIN.

Prices shown already include applicable Kenyan VAT — what you see is what you pay, plus any delivery fee.

Tap 'Add to Cart' on the product listing. If it's greyed out, that item may be temporarily out of stock.
